title: Starting a Revolution in Walton Hall
summary: On Wednesday, May 6, 2015—three months to the day after his heart attack in the exact same classroom—Jordan leads the nine-person Bennett Hall team in presenting their completed ENGL 102 project, The Accessibility Project, in Walton Hall Room 104, winning unanimous adoption from the Office of Educational Accessibility and the University Architect to replace CPI's broken PDF maps.
